sv.title: C-kvinnor sätter ned foten om SD
sv.summary: Om de rödgröna partierna inte kan enas bör Centerpartiet gå i opposition. Det anser partiets kvinnoförbund som nu har fattat beslut i frågan, rapporterar Ekot.

en.title: Centre Party women put their foot down over the Sweden Democrats
en.summary: If the red-greens cannot agree, the Centre Party should go into opposition. That is the view of the party's women's league, which has now made a decision on the matter, reports Ekot.
